## 📋 Description
Brief description of the changes made and what problem they solve.

## 🔄 Type of Change
- [ ] **Bug fix** (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] **New feature** (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] **Breaking change** (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] **Documentation update** (README, API docs, examples)
- [ ] **Performance improvement** (optimization without changing functionality)
- [ ] **Code refactoring** (restructuring without changing functionality)
- [ ] **Dependency update** (updating package dependencies)
- [ ] **Build/CI changes** (changes to build process or CI configuration)

## 🎯 What This PR Addresses
- **Problem**: What issue or limitation does this solve?
- **Solution**: How does this PR solve the problem?
- **Impact**: What's the impact on existing users?

## 🧪 Testing
- [ ] **iOS Testing**: Tested on iOS Simulator/Device
- [ ] **Android Testing**: Tested on Android Emulator/Device
- [ ] **Multiple Sheets**: Tested multiple bottom sheets functionality
- [ ] **Gestures**: Tested drag gestures (close/expand)
- [ ] **Animations**: Verified smooth animations
- [ ] **Safe Area**: Tested safe area handling
- [ ] **Keyboard**: Tested keyboard interactions
- [ ] **Custom Styling**: Tested custom styling options
- [ ] **Edge Cases**: Tested edge cases and error scenarios

## 📱 Screenshots/Videos
If applicable, add screenshots or videos to demonstrate the changes:
- **Before**: Show current behavior
- **After**: Show new behavior
- **Different Platforms**: iOS vs Android if different

## 🔍 Code Quality
- [ ] **TypeScript**: Proper type definitions added/updated
- [ ] **Code Style**: Follows project coding standards
- [ ] **Performance**: No performance regressions
- [ ] **Memory**: No memory leaks introduced
- [ ] **Accessibility**: Maintains or improves accessibility

## 📋 Checklist
- [ ] **Self Review**: I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] **Comments**: I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] **Documentation**: I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] **Warnings**: My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] **Tests**: I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] **Unit Tests**: New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] **Build**: The project builds successfully with my changes
- [ ] **Linting**: Code passes all linting checks

## 🔗 Related Issues
- **Fixes**: Closes #[issue number]
- **Related**: Related to #[issue number]
- **Discussed in**: #[discussion number]

## 📝 Additional Notes
Any additional information or context about the pull request:
- **Breaking Changes**: If any, describe what breaks and migration path
- **Dependencies**: Any new dependencies or version changes
- **Performance Impact**: Any performance implications
- **Future Work**: Any follow-up work needed
- **Review Focus**: Specific areas you'd like reviewers to focus on

## 🚀 Deployment Notes
- [ ] **Version Bump**: Version number updated appropriately
